title: TraceQA run folder
description: The files one run writes. Layout: run.json (RunManifest), events.jsonl (one Event per line), and one folder per browser and viewport holding components.json (ComponentsFile) and, when pictures were asked for, page.png and crops/.

RunManifest.description: run.json. Written at the start and rewritten at the end.

dir.description: Folder name inside the run folder, for example firefox-1280x800.

error.description: Why this target failed, when it did.

Timings.description: Where the time of one target went, in milliseconds. The parts do not add up to durationMs exactly: grouping and writing files are not listed.

openMs.description: Starting the driver if needed, and opening the browser.

loadMs.description: Loading the page and waiting for it to settle, including any settle time asked for.

readMs.description: Running the collector, over all the times it ran.

scrollMs.description: Scrolling and waiting for the page to settle after each scroll.

cropMs.description: Cutting the crops out of the screenshots.

screens.description: How many screens the page was read in.

Event.description: One line of events.jsonl. The same object is sent live to the caller.

seq.description: Starts at 0 and increases by 1 within a run.

type.description: Known values: run.started, target.started, page.opened, elements.collected, page.scrolled, components.grouped, crop.saved, warning, target.retried, target.cancelled, target.finished, run.finished, error.

target.description: The target folder name this event belongs to, when it belongs to one.

data.description: Extra fields that depend on the event type.

ComponentsFile.description: components.json: every interactive component found on one page, in one browser, at one viewport.

fingerprintVersion.description: Version of the recipe that produced the component ids. Ids from different versions must not be compared.

viewport.description: The viewport the page was read at. It differs from the target's when the browser could not give the one asked for, and a viewport_not_reached warning says so.

Component.description: One kind of interactive element. Repeated copies are instances of the same component.

id.description: The fingerprint: 'c_' followed by 12 hex characters. See spec/fingerprint.md.

name.description: Accessible name. When nameIsTemplate is true the instances have different names and this is '*'.

nameChanges.description: True when the name was seen to change while the page was read, as a countdown's or a cart total's does. The id then leaves the name out, so it stays the same from run to run. The name is the one read last.

path.description: Readable structural path, for example 'list "products" > listitem'.

crop.description: Path of a screenshot crop of the component, relative to this file. It is taken from the screen that showed the most of the component while the page was scrolled through. Absent when it never appeared.

locator.description: How to find the component again with a Playwright-style locator. Uniqueness is within this file (one page, one browser); `traceqa codegen` combines the files of every browser.

Instance.description: One actual element on the page.

key.description: The component id, a colon, and the instance's position in document order.

nameSource.description: Where this instance's name came from. Known values: aria-label, aria-labelledby, label, content, alt, title, placeholder, value. Absent when the name is empty.

RunGroup.description: group.json, in runs/g_<id>/. An index over ordinary run folders that belong together, such as the N runs of `traceqa extract --repeat N`. It is not a layout: every member is a normal run folder next to it in the same --out folder, so tools that list runs (MCP list_runs, the SDKs, the run-folder checker) see them unchanged. A group folder has no run.json.

groupId.description: g_ followed by the same shape as a run id. Equals the folder name.

kind.description: What the group is. Known values: repeat (the same page read several times, to find unstable components), site (the pages of one site).

url.description: The page that was asked for.

finishedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC. Absent while the group is still being written.

AxeResults.description: axe.json, written next to components.json only when the run asked for axe-core (`traceqa extract --axe`). The result of one axe-core run per frame, with every violation node placed on the component it belongs to. Automated rules find only part of the accessibility problems a page has; this is not a conformance result. The page's html is never kept.

axeVersion.description: The axe-core version that ran, as it reports itself.

tags.description: The rule tags that were run, for example wcag2aa.

incomplete.description: How many results axe could not decide and left for a person to review (axe's incomplete results), across all frames.

errors.description: Frames in which axe did not run, each with the reason.

AxeViolation.description: One axe rule that failed, with the elements it failed on.

rule.description: axe's rule id, for example color-contrast.

impact.description: axe's impact. Known values: minor, moderate, serious, critical. Absent when axe gave none.

tags.description: axe's tags for the rule, such as wcag143 and wcag2aa.

AxeNode.description: One element an axe rule failed on.

target.description: axe's selector for the element inside its frame.

box.description: In top-level page coordinates, as an instance's box is.

componentId.description: The component the element is, or sits inside. Absent when no component contains it: the finding is then about the page.

viaAncestor.description: True when the element is not itself a component and componentId is the smallest component whose box contains its centre.

StabilityFile.description: stability.json, in runs/g_<id>/ of a `repeat` group. For each target folder name, how often each component was found across the runs. Only targets that completed count: a failed or cancelled target is not a run in which the component was missing.

repeat.description: How many runs were asked for. The runs array is shorter when the group was cancelled.

TargetStability.description: Stability of the components of one target folder (browser and viewport) across the runs.

dir.description: Folder name inside each run folder, for example chromium-1280x800.

runsCompleted.description: In how many runs this target completed. The denominator of every rate below.

components.description: Every component seen in at least one run, by id.

unstableCount.description: How many components carry at least one flag.

ComponentStability.description: How steady one component was across the runs of a group.

name.description: The name in the newest run that had the component.

rate.description: runsPresent divided by the target's runsCompleted, from 0 to 1.

nameVariants.description: The different names seen, sorted. Only one entry unless the component's name changes between runs.

flags.description: Known values: unstable (0 < rate < 1), count_varies (the instance count differs between the runs that had it), state_flaps (visible or enabled differs between those runs), name_varies (more than one name).

InstanceRange.description: Fewest and most instances of a component in the runs that had it.
